status: design approved in structure (the owner, 2026-09-21); built on the staging export for a flyover only; not in the live world
outline: data/landmarks.json rift.extent.polygons: the wall stands on the outline, which runs along the rim

wall.why: Sixteen blocks cannot be walked or jumped; with 17-degree walls the Rift could otherwise be walked into anywhere (RIFT_ZONES section 1).

spires.why: What reads as reaching the sky is height, and height is cheap in spires; they lean and taper so they read as grown.

rubble.why: At each guard site the wall drops to rubble and the spires stop: how a player reads 'this is the way in'. Never below 4 and never gapped, so the rubble cannot be walked over on a slope: the walkway stays the only way in on foot. Loose blocks are scattered on the ground beside it.

gatehouse.marker: an armor stand named for the guard, a placeholder until Codex writes the guards (docs/HANDOVER_CODEX.md item 23)
gatehouse.why: A one-wide walkway, roofed so nothing jumps the guard, closed by a barrier directly behind the guard (RIFT_ZONES section 6).

throat.why: the dig camp must not be a back door onto Victory Road

branch_mouth.why: the south-east branch is entered from its own tip

behind_league.why: the apex beyond the League; G4's walkway

settlements_on_outline.rift_rim_stop: The rim post stands on the outline: the wall stops either side of its town, which leaves an unguarded way in there. The owner decides: a fifth guard at the post, or the wall run round the post's back (open, 2026-09-22).

floor_light.why: Light from below comes from blocks, not the biome (RIFT_ZONES section 7): crying obsidian gives light 10.

biome.spawns: Staging only: the Rift's authored spawn entries name minecraft:windswept_gravelly_hills, so the repainted Rift spawns none of them until data/spawns.json and the tag pack add this biome (RIFT_ZONES section 7). No spawn pool is installed on the staging export, so nothing is lost there.
